I separately implemented the transition and active-path cycle classifier in optimized C++ from the displayed 18 edges and recomputed the entire joint matrix: (1,1):52563, (3,3):282990, (4,4):62952, (5,5):90432, (6,6):24636, (7,7):12840, (8,8):3532, (8,4):1496; sum 531441. Distinct orbit lengths are exactly least periods because cycle traversal closes at its first repeated state. The LCF conjugacy and explicit period-eight/four witness are supplied; auxiliary orbit and depth totals rely on the inspected exhaustive code rather than a second independent full depth replay.
